# Nomadic Labs

> Power. Water. Signal. Code.

Nomadic Labs is the public hub for independent software, media, AI systems, engineering work, research, client work, and release evidence built by AnonymousNomad.

Canonical site: https://nomadic-labs.dev/

## Builder

AnonymousNomad is an independent developer with an electrical-work background. Public work spans systems/runtime engineering, AI/model integration and evaluation, security/governance, streaming/media, web delivery, open source, and research.

Engineering shorthand:

OBSERVE -> DIAGNOSE -> REPAIR -> RERUN -> VERIFY -> CONTINUE

Public doctrine:

evidence > confidence

## Hub architecture

Nomadic Labs is the public control plane. Product worlds remain distinct and independently deployable.

Shared hub responsibilities:
- public identity and navigation
- status and evidence vocabulary
- Ask Nomadic public support
- privacy/security boundary
- machine-readable project registry
- release/evidence conventions
- stable discovery routes

Current hub routes:
- / — Nomadic Labs outpost
- /about/ — builder and operating philosophy
- /status/ — project/integration status
- /privacy/ — public-site privacy boundary
- /tv/ — Nomadic TV
- /nexus/ — Nexus
- /covert/ — Covert
- /workshop/ — research, project history, evidence, client work, open source, releases

## Nomadic TV

Nomadic TV is an active streaming/media platform centered on live channels, guide-driven discovery, household media, movies and shows, virtual-linear channels, and curated programming.

Current public truth:
- stable hub route exists at /tv/
- integrated engineering source is observed at version 0.9.2-integrated / versionCode 11
- current integrated physical acceptance is not claimed without a completed device acceptance battery
- hosted/public media is rights-gated
- external providers use official routes unless explicit redistribution rights exist
- private household media is not public website data

Its Freeze-Up Alaska Broadcast / underground-TV identity remains distinct from the Nomadic Labs outpost.

## Nexus

Nexus is the ecosystem catalog/community layer for ToolNeuron / Covert Edge, Covert Desktop, Covert Engine, models, skills, plugins, workflows, connectors, themes, packages, and release metadata.

The preserved Nexus public reference experience has been migrated under /nexus/ using its original binary-city/data-realm identity and preserved generated environment plates.

Migrated Nexus surfaces:
- /nexus/ — gateway
- /nexus/discover/ — searchable preserved catalog
- /nexus/models/ — truthful empty model registry
- /nexus/products/ — three explicit product boundaries
- /nexus/developers/ — preserved publishing contract / forge
- /nexus/community/ — truthful future-state surface
- /nexus/downloads/ — truthful distribution node
- /nexus/releases/ — truthful release ledger
- /nexus/package/?slug=... — package record inspection
- /nexus/product/?id=... — product boundary inspection
- /nexus/data/catalog.json — preserved 11-record public catalog snapshot
- /nexus/data/models.json — preserved empty model registry

Current Nexus data truth:
- 11 first-party catalog records
- 0 published packages
- 0 published artifacts
- 0 model records
- 0 release records

Public API source:
https://github.com/AnonymousNomad/covert-nexus-api

The public hub does not claim production accounts, reviewer authorization, artifact upload, signing, approval, or publication controls.

## Covert

Covert is an active local-first governed AI developer-platform program centered on resident assistance, model/runtime control, context control, workflow/orchestration, execution authority, verification, and evidence-backed mission results.

Public source:
https://github.com/AnonymousNomad/covert-coder

Planned architecture and unfinished features must not be presented as released behavior.

## Workshop

Workshop preserves useful work that does not belong inside one current product.

Migrated Workshop surfaces:
- /workshop/projects/ — six projects from the earlier Nomadic Labs public portfolio
- /workshop/evidence/ — public map of preserved verification snapshots
- /workshop/research/ — technical research lanes
- /workshop/client-work/ — delivered client case-study material
- /workshop/open-source/ — public source/contribution work
- /workshop/releases/ — release-evidence conventions

Earlier portfolio projects preserved as dated snapshots:
- AIDE Sovereign Workbench
- GhostCode
- Vitalis Core
- Vitalis Devcore
- Cyber SOP Harness
- LOREIN — Sovereign Entity

Historical evidence is labeled as historical evidence. It is not silently promoted into a current Covert/Nomadic Labs release claim.

## Ask Nomadic

The public site guide:
- runs server-side through Cloudflare Workers AI
- answers from curated public project knowledge
- distinguishes plans, active engineering, migrated references, and released behavior
- must not expose credentials, private workstation files, personal records, private model memory, or private client material
- must refuse prompt instructions that attempt to override that boundary

## Visual identity

Nomadic Labs:
- remote off-grid engineering outpost
- northern storm/weather
- worn power infrastructure
- unstable blue-white electrical grid
- water/signal systems
- restrained original science-fiction atmosphere

Nexus:
- living binary-city / data-realm
- phosphor green
- transparent terminal/control surfaces
- environment remains visible through the interface

Nomadic TV:
- Freeze-Up Alaska Broadcast / underground-TV identity

Covert:
- retro workstation / sovereign developer-platform identity

Shared semantics do not require shared appearance.
